text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While piling on training for the Satsuki 
Sho, Mejiro Bright's challenge became 
clear: she needed the ability to dictate 
the race's pace herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, they sought advice on race management 
from Mejiro Ryan, who gladly offered to 
coach based on her own personal 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having tasted the very same anguish as 
Mejiro Bright, she wanted her to run a 
race free of regrets— With those feelings 
in her heart, she challenged the 
long-sought Mejiro Triple Crown.
